facts.text: Fontainebleau Las Vegas sits on the north end of the Las Vegas Strip.
facts.excerpt: Situated on the north end of the Las Vegas Strip, Fontainebleau Las Vegas provides a prime and easily accessible location

facts.text: The resort is less than a 20-minute ride from Harry Reid International Airport.
facts.excerpt: less than a 20-minute ride from Harry Reid International Airport

facts.text: The resort is a 10-minute walk from the Las Vegas Convention Center.
facts.excerpt: a 10-minute walk from the Las Vegas Convention Center

facts.text: Fontainebleau Las Vegas was honored with One MICHELIN Key for a second year in 2026.
facts.excerpt: Honored with One MICHELIN Key for a second year in 2026

facts.text: The Oasis Pool covers six acres.
facts.excerpt: Our expansive, six-acre, Oasis Pool boasts four bars, La Côte, daylife destination LIV Beach, and a 2,300SF gaming area.

facts.text: The Oasis Pool includes LIV Beach, a daylife destination.
facts.excerpt: Oasis Pool boasts four bars, La Côte, daylife destination LIV Beach

facts.text: LIV Beach hosts headlining performers such as Tiesto and John Summit, with VIP daybeds, cabanas and villa cabanas in an ambiance reminiscent of the French Riviera.
facts.excerpt: With world-class headlining performers like Tiësto and John Summit with VIP daybed, cabana and villa cabana options amongst a captivating ambiance reminiscent of the French Riviera

facts.text: The Legacy Pool is a secluded pool reserved for guests 21 and over.
facts.excerpt: A secluded experience reserved for guests of Fontainebleau 21 and over, the Legacy Pool

facts.text: Gigi's is a poolside spot decorated with exotic lanterns, vibrant textiles and potted palms.
facts.excerpt: Exotic lanterns, vibrant textiles, and swaying potted palms make Gigi’s a poolside oasis

facts.text: Lapis Spa & Wellness offers signature treatments such as hydrotherapy and an Event Sauna.
facts.excerpt: a sanctuary for the senses with signature treatments like hydrotherapy and a state-of-the-art Event Sauna

facts.text: The Lapis Spa & Wellness was recognized by the World Spa Awards as World's Best Casino Hotel Spa 2024.
facts.excerpt: World’s Best Casino Hotel Spa 2024 & Nevada’s Best Hotel Spa 2024

facts.text: Registered hotel guests have exclusive reservation access to Lapis Spa & Wellness from Friday to Sunday.
facts.excerpt: Registered hotel guests enjoy exclusive reservation access to Lapis Spa & Wellness from Friday – Sunday.

facts.text: The fitness center has wall-to-wall windows overlooking the Strip.
facts.excerpt: Discover a premium fitness facility featuring wall-to-wall windows overlooking the Strip.

facts.text: The wellness offering includes the spa, a fitness center, the NutriDrip IV Drip Lounge, IGK Salon and a nail lounge.
facts.excerpt: our revolutionary spa, state-of-the-art fitness center, NutriDrip IV Drip Lounge, IGK Salon, and premium nail lounge

facts.text: Gold rooms have Strip, mountain or pool views.
facts.excerpt: Strip, Mountain, or Pool Views

facts.text: Some Fleur de Lis suites include an in-suite wellness room.
facts.excerpt: In-suite Wellness Room

facts.text: The Hall of Excellence is a memorabilia museum curated by Tom Brady and sportscaster Jim Gray.
facts.excerpt: Curated by seven-time Super Bowl champion Tom Brady and sportscasting legend Jim Gray, this museum experience reveals untold stories through extraordinary artifacts

facts.text: The Hall of Excellence's Trophy Room features the Vince Lombardi Trophy, the Heisman Trophy and the Claret Jug.
facts.excerpt: At the center of the experience is the Trophy Room – featuring the Vince Lombardi Trophy, the Heisman Trophy, the Claret Jug

facts.text: BleauLive Theater has three levels and cutting-edge audiovisual technology.
facts.excerpt: the theater at Fontainebleau Las Vegas boasts three levels of meticulous detail and cutting-edge audiovisual technology

facts.text: Ito is an omakase restaurant on the top floor serving fish flown in daily from Japan to 12 guests per seating.
facts.excerpt: Exclusive omakase experience, located on the top floor, serving fish flown in daily from Japan for an intimate seating of 12 guests.

facts.text: Mother Wolf, from chef Evan Funke, serves Roman classics.
facts.excerpt: A Hollywood concept from the larger-than-life chef Evan Funke, serving Roman classics.

facts.text: The dining collection includes over 30 restaurants, lounges and cafes.
facts.excerpt: 30 unique restaurants, lounges, and cafés

facts.text: The resort has over 20 restaurants and bars.
facts.excerpt: indulge in one of over 20 restaurants and bars

facts.text: The Shops at Fontainebleau include Graff's largest North American salon.
facts.excerpt: Graff’s largest North American salon, featuring rare diamond jewelry

facts.text: Nightlife includes live music at Nowhere, Bleau Bar and the LIV nightclub.
facts.excerpt: indulge in live music at Nowhere, mix and mingle at Bleau Bar, or party in style at LIV.

facts.text: The resort has a Vegas Loop passenger station for the underground Tesla-powered transit system.
facts.excerpt: The Vegas Loop is a high-speed, underground transportation system powered by Tesla vehicles.

facts.text: From the resort, the Vegas Loop reaches all Las Vegas Convention Center terminals.
facts.excerpt: Las Vegas Convention Center (all terminals)

facts.text: Self-parking is included in the resort fee for hotel guests for their stay.
facts.excerpt: Self-parking is included in the Resort Fee for hotel guests for the duration of their stay.

facts.text: Valet validation is not available to registered hotel guests.
facts.excerpt: Valet validation is not available to registered hotel guests and is subject to special events and holidays.

facts.text: The Oasis Pool is non-smoking.
facts.excerpt: For the enjoyment of all guests, the Oasis Pool is non-smoking.

facts.text: Cabana and daybed reservations at the pool are available for registered hotel guests.
facts.excerpt: Cabanas & daybed reservations are available for registered hotel guests.

facts.text: The resort calls itself the only MICHELIN Key resort and casino in Las Vegas.
facts.excerpt: As the only MICHELIN Key resort and casino in Las Vegas
